data.gender_notes: Aalifa is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root ‘alaf’, meaning to be high, exalted, or noble. In Islamic tradition, Aalifa signifies a woman of noble character and virtuous conduct. The name Aalifa carries the meaning “Exalted, Noble” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Aalifa usually hope their child will grow to embody exalted, noble and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of spiritual elevation and noble character in Islam.
data.etymology: Aalifa belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Exalted, Noble.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aalifa total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
